sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 21 (verifier_entrypoint_is_safe_and_always_scores) and Internal Quality Checks row 21 (no annotation); Deterministic Checks rows check-verifier-contract.py, check-scoring-policy.py, check-runtime-contract-strings.py
evidence: tests/test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template (sha256 bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa for both); tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml and tests/Dockerfile also diff clean against the template; `bash -n` passes. Contract walk: write_zero_reward (L60) runs before `trap cleanup EXIT` (L61) and the cleanup trap calls ensure_reward (L20-23,L39) on every exit under `set -euo pipefail`; the only pre-trap commands (L10-12) are mkdir/chmod on the harness log dir with `|| true` on /tests. The zero JSON (L8) carries reward, all five dimensions, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op. No `exec` builtin (only `find -exec` at L86). Refuses missing /app/server.js (L68-70) and any symlink outside or escaping /app/node_modules (L72-83). Copies /app aside (L90-95) and launches via `setsid env -i PATH NODE_PATH HOME PORT=3000 DB_PATH setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups` (L104-111). Liveness probe on /api/health then / for up to 30 s before any RewardKit call, exit 0 with zero reward if not ready (L115-125). Restart helper generated by heredoc+sed, chmod 755, APP_RESTART_HELPER exported (L127-193) and consumed by scored/functional/judge.toml:27. Gates suite (L213) then score.py with 0 continue / 1 keep detailed record / other write_zero_reward (L217-222); scored suite (L224) then score.py || write_zero_reward (L227). score.py catches all exceptions to exit 2 and returns 1 on gate failure, writing reward 0 when floors are unmet or scored is absent. Budgets nest: gates 2x600=1200<1500; scored functional individual 16x550=8800 + polish 900 + visual 900 = 10600 < 11100 (run sequentially with --max-concurrent-agent 1); 1500+11100+~60 s probes < verifier 13200. Launch assumptions are public: integration.md states ordinary user, not run from /app, port 3000 on 0.0.0.0, NODE_PATH, HOME, DB_PATH, GET /api/health returning 200; golden server.js honors PORT/DB_PATH and resolves files from __dirname. Adversarial probes: a dead app that answers any HTTP status passes only liveness and still must clear the judged gates; a crash/timeout at any stage leaves 0.0 (pre-written or gates-stage score.py record), never an unscored rollout. Conforming-app risk: an app needing >30 s to start would score 0 with the 30 s limit unstated in the brief, but this is template-controlled and the brief asks for a plain node start. Risk=true because no full configured test.sh execution on these bytes exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'A full configured grading run of this candidate ... absent'); the scripted golden run exercised the uid-65534/env -i launch but not test.sh's reward-on-failure paths.
